project.name: Trading Portfolio Pro
project.description: Cross-device trading portfolio tracker, real-time PnL calculator, TradingView scanner & assistant with Google Sheets cloud sync.

frontend.injection: Shadow DOM for styling isolation (content.js / content-loader.js)

backend.cloud_sync: Google Apps Script Web App / Google Sheets
backend.cors_proxy: Background message passing (FETCH_PRICES, FETCH_DEEP_RESEARCH, SCAN_STOCKS, SCAN_CRYPTO, SYNC_SHEETS_*)

database.type: Local Storage DB + Google Sheets Cloud Mirror
database.format: JSON structure for portfolio, settings, trade history, signals, and scanner caches

tables.name: tpp_trade_history
tables.description: Realized closed trades & T0 trade history

tables.name: tpp_scanner_results
tables.description: AI Top Picks scanner results and timestamp

tables.name: tpp_caught_signals
tables.description: Signals caught from TradingView Pine Script alerts

api_endpoints.purpose: 2-Way Cross-Device sync for stock and crypto portfolio items with Google Sheets.
Fetch real-time stock/crypto prices, technical indicators, and deep research snapshots.
Market scanner for Vietnam stock exchange tickers (HOSE, HNX, UPCOM).
Market scanner for major cryptocurrency pairs.
AI screener ranking, detailed symbol advice, deep stock research, and portfolio assistant.
Alternative AI provider for chat, research, and planning.
Push proactive alerts (TP, SL, RSI Oversold T0) and Pine Script signals to user's phone.

business_rules: Prices are stored as Full Prices (e.g. 115000) but displayed as Divided Prices (/1000 = 115.0) for VN market via getDivisor().
Crypto and global assets use divisor = 1.
Proactive monitoring runs every 10 minutes via background alarms when Telegram alerts are enabled.
T0 rule: Mini-trade profits are deducted from original position entry price to lower cost basis.
Position Sizing: Risk per trade defaults to 2% of total account balance; formula: Qty = (Balance * Risk%) / |Entry - SL|.
Swing trading setups must pass a minimum Risk/Reward threshold (default R:R >= 1:2).
Google Sheets cloud sync pushes updates on trade save/edit/delete/T0/close when sheetsAutoPush is enabled.
TradingView GoPro dialog suppression enforces opacity: 0 and pointer-events: none via preemptive CSS, MutationObserver, and 250ms polling loop.
features: Portfolio Management (CRUD, Position Sizing, Sector Allocation Bar)
Cross-Device Cloud Sync via Google Sheets & Apps Script (Pull & Push)
TradingView Injected Shadow DOM Widget across websites with GoPro ad suppression
Multi-market Scanner (VN Stocks & Crypto) with Pine Script v5.5 Confluence Scoring Engine
Smart Stock Assistant & Portfolio Trading Assistant (Hybrid Quant + AI)
Multi-Theme Support: Default, Cyber Pulse (Neon), Crystal Glass (Glassmorphism)

patterns: ES Modules in content script using dynamic import loader (content-loader.js).
Shadow DOM used for floating widget to encapsulate CSS without affecting host page styles.
Event Delegation in ui.js to manage dynamic lists cleanly.
CORS Bypass: Webpage content scripts cannot call external APIs directly; requests must route through background.js via chrome.runtime.sendMessage.
Hybrid AI Architecture: Calculate all numbers (scores, pivot levels, R:R, position size) locally first, then pass structured context to AI.
gotchas: Cannot use fetch() to TradingView or Google Apps Script directly in content.js due to page CSP/CORS. Must proxy via background.js.
POST requests to Google Apps Script Web Apps should use Content-Type: text/plain to prevent CORS preflight redirect failures.
Download anchors must be appended to document.body (not ShadowRoot) to trigger file downloads in all browsers.
TradingView GoPro dialogs should be suppressed with opacity: 0 and pointer-events: none (rather than display: none) to avoid triggering TradingView's ad-block re-render handlers.
ui.js is very large (~1950 lines); new assistant and deep features should be isolated into modular files (e.g. assistant_engine.js, ui_assistant.js) rather than expanding existing god-nodes.
conventions: Use getDivisor(symbol) to dynamically adjust price displays without mutating underlying storage.
Preserve existing storage keys in storage.js to maintain backwards compatibility.
Keep popup.html element IDs in sync with ui.js event binding selectors.
